title: Two Sum Sorted
definition: If an array is strictly sorted, Two Sum can be solved in O(1) space by placing one pointer at `index 0` and one at `index N-1`. If `sum < target`, increment left. If `sum > target`, decrement right.
simpleExplanation: Since it's sorted, if your guess is too low, move the left finger to the right to get a bigger number. If it's too high, move the right finger to the left to get a smaller number.

answers.question: **Basic:** Identify the core logic required to implement Two Sum Sorted.
**Intermediate 1:** Solve a standard problem using Two Sum Sorted in O(N log N) or O(N) time.
**Intermediate 2:** Adapt Two Sum Sorted to handle strings or distinct objects instead of numbers.
**Advanced:** Use Two Sum Sorted to solve a complex sub-array or sub-string problem (e.g. Longest non-repeating).
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize Two Sum Sorted to achieve strictly O(1) space constraints while maintaining linear time.
